title: Munir Zulu v Attorney General and Ors (2025/CCZ/0011) [2025] ZMCC 10 (4 June 2025)
case_name: Munir Zulu v Attorney General and Ors
issue_tags: stay of vacation of parliamentary seat pending appeal
binding effect of full bench decisions on single judge
Belemu Sibanze and Nickson Chilangwa applied
outcome_detail: Summons dismissed as misconceived and frivolous; petitioner aware of full bench decisions in Belemu Sibanze and Nickson Chilangwa, and single judge has no liberty to disregard full bench judgments; granting stay would leave Lumezi Constituency without representation contrary to representative democracy; parties to bear own costs
